maps.disclaimer.p4: Anonomi does not operate, control, or audit third-party tile servers. You are responsible for selecting map sources that match your privacy, trust, and operational security requirements.
maps.exporter.howItWorksDesc: Move the map until the area inside the selection frame matches what you want. Then pick the zoom detail and export locally. No uploads. No accounts.

paylinks.meta.title: Anonomi Paylinks
paylinks.meta.description: Private donation buttons for publishers. Fresh subaddress per donation, no persistent wallet exposure.
paylinks.hero.tagline: MONERO • NO PERSISTENT ADDRESS • QR HANDOFF
paylinks.hero.heading: Private donations without exposing your wallet.
paylinks.hero.description: Anonomi Paylinks lets publishers embed a “Donate” button on their website or blog without revealing a long-lived wallet address. Each donation request generates a fresh subaddress — reducing correlation risk and protecting both publishers and donors.
paylinks.hero.disclaimer: Beta release. Monero only. We never ask for your spend key — we can’t move your funds.
paylinks.who.heading: Built for people under pressure.
paylinks.who.description: Traditional donation buttons expose a static wallet address that can be tracked, correlated, and used against you. Paylinks changes that.
paylinks.who.journalists.title: Journalists
paylinks.who.journalists.desc: Receive support without creating a permanent financial trail that can be subpoenaed or surveilled.
paylinks.who.bloggers.title: Bloggers
paylinks.who.bloggers.desc: Accept donations from readers without exposing a wallet that links all your supporters together.
paylinks.who.activists.title: Activists
paylinks.who.activists.desc: Protect your donors. If one supporter is compromised, they can’t expose others.
paylinks.who.creators.title: Content creators
paylinks.who.creators.desc: Monetize your work without relying on platforms that track, censor, or de-platform.
paylinks.how.heading: How Paylinks works
paylinks.how.description: Two roles: publishers who receive donations, and donors who send them. Both benefit from fresh addresses and minimal metadata.
paylinks.how.publishers.title: For publishers
paylinks.how.publishers.step1.title: Create a Paylink
paylinks.how.publishers.step1.desc: Enter your Monero address and private view key. Configure an optional label and index range.
paylinks.how.publishers.step2.title: Embed the button
paylinks.how.publishers.step2.desc: Copy the HTML snippet and paste it on your website, blog, or anywhere you want to receive donations.
paylinks.how.publishers.step3.title: Receive donations
paylinks.how.publishers.step3.desc: Donors click the button, get a fresh address, and send payment from their wallet. Funds arrive in your wallet.
paylinks.how.donors.title: For donors
paylinks.how.donors.step1.title: Click the donate button
paylinks.how.donors.step1.desc: Find a Paylink button on a publisher’s site and click it to start a donation.
paylinks.how.donors.step2.title: Get a fresh address
paylinks.how.donors.step2.desc: Optionally enter an amount and description. A unique subaddress and QR code are generated just for you.
paylinks.how.donors.step3.title: Send from your wallet
paylinks.how.donors.step3.desc: Scan the QR or copy the address into your Monero wallet app (Monerujo, Cake Wallet, etc.) and send.
paylinks.privacy.heading: Privacy by design
paylinks.privacy.description: Paylinks is built to minimize data exposure for both publishers and donors.
paylinks.privacy.noSpendKey.title: No spend key
paylinks.privacy.noSpendKey.desc: We only use your private view key to derive subaddresses. We can’t spend your funds — ever.
paylinks.privacy.noLogging.title: No payment logging
paylinks.privacy.noLogging.desc: We don’t log donor IPs, amounts, descriptions, or timestamps. Payment metadata exists only in the donor’s browser.
paylinks.privacy.freshAddress.title: Fresh address per request
paylinks.privacy.freshAddress.desc: Each donor gets a unique subaddress. No single address links all your supporters together.
paylinks.privacy.donorIsolation.title: Donor isolation
paylinks.privacy.donorIsolation.desc: If one donor is coerced into revealing their transaction, they can’t expose other donors — each received a different address.
paylinks.tor.heading: Clearnet & Tor separation
paylinks.tor.description: Paylinks runs separate services for clearnet and Tor. This is a security feature, not a limitation.
paylinks.tor.noCrossOrigin.title: No cross-origin requests
paylinks.tor.noCrossOrigin.desc: The clearnet site only talks to the clearnet API. The onion site only talks to the onion API. No mixing.
paylinks.tor.trafficIsolation.title: Traffic isolation
paylinks.tor.trafficIsolation.desc: Tor traffic stays within Tor. No exit nodes, no clearnet exposure — your activity remains within the onion network.
paylinks.tor.independentInfra.title: Independent infrastructure
paylinks.tor.independentInfra.desc: Clearnet and onion services run on separate infrastructure. If one is compromised, the other continues independently.
paylinks.tor.createWherePublish.title: Create where you publish
paylinks.tor.createWherePublish.desc: Want a donate button for your clearnet site? Create it here. For your onion site? Use the onion version of Paylinks.
paylinks.distinction.heading: Paylinks vs. Messenger Payment Requests
paylinks.distinction.description: Anonomi has two ways to handle Monero payments — use the right one for your situation.
paylinks.distinction.paylinks.title: Paylinks
paylinks.distinction.paylinks.desc: Public donation buttons for websites and blogs. Address generation happens server-side using your view key.
paylinks.distinction.paylinks.bestFor: Best for: Publishers receiving donations from unknown supporters.
paylinks.distinction.messenger.title: Messenger Payment Requests
paylinks.distinction.messenger.desc: Private peer-to-peer payments inside encrypted conversations. Address generation happens client-side in your wallet.
paylinks.distinction.messenger.bestFor: Best for: Trusted contacts exchanging payments privately.
paylinks.getStarted.heading: Get started
paylinks.getStarted.description: Create a Paylink in under a minute. You’ll need your Monero primary address and private view key.
paylinks.getStarted.create.title: Create a Paylink
paylinks.getStarted.create.desc: Generate a donate button for your website. You’ll get an embeddable HTML snippet and a unique paylink URL.
paylinks.getStarted.delete.title: Delete a Paylink
paylinks.getStarted.delete.desc: Remove a paylink you no longer need. You can delete a single paylink or all paylinks for a wallet.
home.meta.title: Anonomi
home.meta.description: A privacy suite for high-threat environments: messenger, offline maps, and paylinks.
home.hero.subtitle: Resistant to censorship, control and coercion
home.hero.description.after: regimes survive through surveillance, centralization, and fear. Anonomi removes those levers — no servers to seize, no metadata to harvest, and no infrastructure that can be flipped into a tool of repression.
home.manifesto.heading: Manifesto
home.manifesto.p1: Power doesn’t just accumulate — it consolidates. Surveillance is no longer an exception or a scandal; it’s an operating system for modern institutions. Corporations monetize attention and behavior. States normalize monitoring. “Public safety” becomes an all-purpose excuse. And the price is metadata: who you talk to, when, where, how often — enough to map your life without reading a single message.
home.manifesto.p2: Anonomi is built for people who can’t afford to be naive. Assume the network is watched. Assume disruption, blocking, and manipulation. Assume devices get searched. Assume contacts get pressured. When the internet is the threat, go offline. When the network is hostile, route through Tor.
home.products.heading: Anonomi is a privacy suite for hostile conditions.
home.products.description: Built for high-risk environments: decentralized messaging, offline navigation tooling, and privacy-preserving payment requests. No trackers. No analytics. No cookies.
home.products.messenger.description: Decentralized messaging over Tor or fully offline. No servers. Built to stop metadata exposure.
home.products.paylinks.description: Create a donate button without exposing a long-lived wallet address. Each donation request generates a fresh subaddress.
home.products.maps.description: Generate offline tile packs locally in your browser for offline navigation.
home.open.heading: Open
home.open.description: Anonomi is built in public. Auditable code, community scrutiny, and designs that assume hostile conditions — not corporate platforms, not walled gardens.
home.open.opensource.title: Open source
home.open.opensource.desc: Code you can inspect, fork, and verify. Security through transparency, not marketing promises.
home.open.notrackers.title: No trackers
home.open.notrackers.desc: No analytics, no ad pixels, no behavioral profiling. Your device is not a product.
home.open.community.title: Community-driven
home.open.community.desc: Built for real users in real risk. Decisions should be accountable to the people who rely on it.
home.open.onionrepo.heading: Onion repository
home.open.onionrepo.p1.after: Anonomi is mirrored as a Tor onion service so code and releases remain accessible where GitHub and developer platforms are blocked, monitored, or censored.
home.open.onionrepo.p2: If you can reach Tor, you can audit the code — no accounts, no permissions, no gatekeepers.
home.open.onionrepo.explore: Explore the code in our repo (onion)
home.open.lovesfor.heading: Anonomi loves Tor
home.open.lovesfor.p1.before: Tor is not the “dark web” — it’s a
home.open.lovesfor.p1.after: . It protects metadata, resists censorship, and removes intermediaries between you and the services you use.
home.open.lovesfor.p2: Anonomi is built on Tor because privacy should not require trust in platforms, providers, or gatekeepers.
home.open.lovesfor.cta: Tor is not the Dark Web — read more
home.about.heading: About Us
home.about.subtitle: Our community and goals
home.about.p1: We’re a global community of contributors with a shared goal: to keep private, resilient communication possible — even when power centralizes, networks are hostile, and trust assumptions fail.
home.about.p2: Anonomi is developed by people who believe privacy is not a feature you enable, but a condition you defend. Our focus is on practical tools for real-world risk: decentralized by design, usable offline, and honest about their limitations.
home.about.building.title: What we’re building
home.about.building.desc: A decentralized communications suite — messaging, private payments, and offline maps — designed to keep working when networks are blocked, monitored, or unavailable.
home.about.building.community.title: Community-driven
home.about.building.community.desc: Decisions are shaped by contributors and users, not sponsors or institutions.
home.about.building.threat.title: Threat-aware by default
home.about.building.threat.desc: We assume surveillance, coercion, and disruption are realistic risks.
home.about.project.title: Anonomi Project
home.support.heading: Support the Project
home.support.description: Anonomi is an early-stage, independent project. It exists because some people believe private communication should remain possible even under pressure — and are willing to contribute time, infrastructure, or resources to make that happen.
home.support.devs.title: Developers & contributors
home.support.devs.desc: Android, networking, cryptography, UX, documentation — contributions of all sizes matter. Review code, propose improvements, or help stress-test assumptions.
home.support.financial.title: Financial support & Tor infrastructure
home.support.financial.p1: Infrastructure, hardware, testing devices, and long-term maintenance require funding. Financial support helps keep the project independent, sustainable, and operational.
home.support.financial.p2: Part of this support goes directly toward contributing to the Tor ecosystem by running relays and bridges — strengthening the network that millions of people around the globe depend on.
home.support.financial.p3: Sponsorship does not equal influence. Anonomi is governed by its community — not sponsors, not donors, not institutions.
home.support.donate.title: Donate (privacy-respecting)
home.support.donate.desc: If you donate, Monero is preferred. Bitcoin is accepted but is public by default.
home.support.donate.xmr.desc: Donate using Anonomi Paylinks — each donation generates a fresh subaddress for privacy.
home.support.donate.tip: Tip: for network privacy, use Tor Browser when viewing this page. For donation privacy, prefer Monero.
messenger.meta.title: Anonomi Messenger: Decentralized communication for hostile environments
messenger.meta.description: Decentralized messaging for high-threat environments. Online over Tor or fully offline.
messenger.hero.heading: Messaging built for hostile conditions.
messenger.hero.description: Anonomi Messenger is an open source decentralized communication tool designed for high-threat environments. It works online over Tor, or completely offline over Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and external storage.
messenger.hero.disclaimer: Android-only. Built to reduce metadata exposure — not to promise magic anonymity.
messenger.features.heading: The ultimate privacy tool
messenger.features.description: Anonomi Messenger is built around three pillars: communication, offline capabilities, and privacy & safety tools.
messenger.download.heading: Download Anonomi Messenger
messenger.download.messenger.label: Anonomi Messenger
messenger.download.postbox.label: Anonomi Postbox
messenger.cat.communication.desc: Messaging, groups, voice, walkie-talkie, and decentralized blogs.
messenger.cat.privacy.desc: Payments, voice distortion, panic button, and stealth mode.
messenger.cat.offline.desc: Transports, offline maps, app distribution, and Postbox.
messenger.messaging.title: Messaging
messenger.messaging.desc: Encrypted, decentralized messaging designed for hostile networks — online over Tor or fully offline over local transports. No central infrastructure to seize, log, or subpoena.
messenger.messaging.noServers.desc: No central infrastructure to seize, log, or subpoena.
messenger.messaging.tor.desc: Route communication through Tor, with bridges when blocked.
messenger.messaging.offline.desc: Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and external storage support when the network is the threat.
messenger.messaging.media.desc: Text, images, voice, and location sharing in every conversation.
messenger.messaging.link: Learn how Anonomi communicates in hostile environments
messenger.groups.title: Groups & Open Groups
messenger.groups.desc: Create private groups for trusted circles or open groups (forums) for broader communities. Both support full media — text, images, voice, and location sharing.
messenger.groups.private.desc: Invite-only groups for trusted contacts. All messages are encrypted and synced peer-to-peer.
messenger.groups.open.desc: Public discussion spaces that anyone with an invitation link can join. Threaded conversations for organized discussion.
messenger.groups.media.desc: Text, images, voice messages, and location sharing work in both private groups and forums.
messenger.groups.threads.desc: Reply to specific messages in group conversations to keep discussions organized and easy to follow.
messenger.voice.title: Voice Messages
messenger.voice.desc: Record and send voice messages in any conversation. Voice data is encrypted and transmitted through the same peer-to-peer network as text and images.
messenger.voice.record.desc: Hold the microphone button to record, release to review or send. Works in private chats and groups.
messenger.voice.encrypted.desc: Voice data is encrypted end-to-end and routed through the same peer-to-peer network as all other messages.
messenger.voice.everywhere.desc: Send voice messages in private chats, groups, and forums — over Tor or any offline transport.
messenger.voice.playback.desc: Play voice messages directly in the conversation without leaving the chat or opening a separate player.
messenger.walkie.title: Walkie-Talkie
messenger.walkie.desc: Push-to-talk voice messaging via the volume button. Hold to record, release to send. Incoming messages auto-play for hands-free communication in the field.
messenger.walkie.trigger.desc: Press and hold the volume button to record. Release to send instantly — no need to touch the screen.
messenger.walkie.autoplay.desc: Incoming walkie-talkie messages play automatically through the speaker for true hands-free operation.
messenger.walkie.oneConvo.desc: Select a contact and use the volume button to send instant voice bursts — simple, focused, and distraction-free.
messenger.walkie.encrypted.desc: All walkie-talkie audio is end-to-end encrypted and routed through the same secure network as regular messages.
messenger.blogs.title: Blogs
messenger.blogs.desc: Publish and follow blogs without servers or platforms. Posts sync peer-to-peer through the same decentralized network used for messaging.
messenger.blogs.create.desc: Write blog posts with text, images, and offline map locations.
messenger.blogs.like.desc: Interact with posts from people you follow — reactions and comments sync peer-to-peer.
messenger.blogs.reblog.desc: Share posts from others to your own blog, amplifying content across the network.
messenger.blogs.feed.desc: A unified feed of posts from all blogs you follow, with individual blog views available.
messenger.blogs.rss.desc: Import RSS feeds from URLs or files and follow external content alongside peer blogs.
messenger.blogs.sharing.desc: Invite contacts to follow your blog or share your blog status for discovery.
messenger.distorted.title: Distorted Voice
messenger.distorted.desc: Optional dynamic voice distortion applied to voice messages to reduce identification risk. Distortion is applied at recording time, so the original voice never leaves the device.
messenger.distorted.onDevice.desc: Distortion is applied before the audio leaves your device. The original voice is never transmitted or stored.
messenger.distorted.dynamic.desc: Voice characteristics are altered dynamically to prevent voiceprint identification while keeping speech intelligible.
messenger.distorted.optional.desc: Enable or disable distortion for each voice message. Choose when anonymity matters and when clarity is more important.
messenger.distorted.walkie.desc: Voice distortion can be applied to walkie-talkie messages too — protecting your identity in real-time communication.
messenger.panic.title: Panic Button
messenger.panic.desc.before: A last-resort mechanism triggered by a
messenger.panic.desc.after: that you define. The trigger works across all screens — including the stealth calculator — with no need to navigate the app.
messenger.panic.trigger.desc: Define a personal sequence of short and long volume presses. Only you know the pattern.
messenger.panic.options.desc: Choose what happens when triggered: sign out, delete your account, or show a choice dialog at the moment of activation.
messenger.panic.contacts.desc: Designate trusted contacts who automatically receive a panic alert when the sequence is triggered.
messenger.panic.stealth.desc: The panic sequence can be triggered from the calculator disguise screen — no need to unlock the real interface first.
messenger.panic.link: Learn how the panic button works
messenger.stealth.title: Stealth Mode
messenger.stealth.desc.after: When stealth mode is enabled, the app disguises itself as a functional calculator. A hidden interaction unlocks the real interface.
messenger.stealth.disguise.desc: The app icon, name, and interface are replaced with a fully functional calculator that works normally.
messenger.stealth.unlock.desc: A secret interaction within the calculator reveals the real Anonomi interface. Only you know the unlock method.
messenger.stealth.noTraces.desc: Anonomi doesn’t appear in recent apps, notifications, or system logs while stealth mode is active.
messenger.stealth.persistent.desc: The calculator disguise persists across reboots and app updates — no need to re-enable it each time.
messenger.payments.title: Private Payments
messenger.payments.desc: Monero payment requests designed to avoid leaking wallet metadata through unsafe channels.
messenger.payments.inChat.desc: Request a payment inside the conversation.
messenger.payments.subaddress.desc: Generate a dedicated subaddress per request to avoid persistent identifiers.
messenger.payments.qr.desc: Send a QR with subaddress + amount + description for scanning in a wallet app.
messenger.payments.metadata.desc: Avoid sharing payment details through insecure channels.
messenger.payments.link: See how private Monero payment requests work
messenger.transports.title: Transports
messenger.transports.desc: Choose the best path for the situation: Tor when the internet is usable, local links when the internet is the threat.
messenger.transports.tor.desc: Secure and anonymized routing over the internet. Bridges when Tor is blocked.
messenger.transports.wifi.desc: Communicate inside a local network with no traffic leaving the area.
messenger.transports.bluetooth.desc: Proximity comms for situations without internet or Wi-Fi infrastructure.
messenger.transports.storage.desc: Store-and-forward via SD card or file transfer for checkpoints and border crossings.
messenger.transports.link: Explore real-world scenarios and transport tradeoffs
messenger.maps.title: Offline Maps & Location Sharing
messenger.maps.desc: Share locations without contacting external map servers. Import tile packs for offline navigation.
messenger.maps.noCalls.desc: Designed to avoid third-party map providers.
messenger.maps.tileImport.desc: Import trusted tile packs for fully offline usage.
messenger.maps.secureShare.desc: Send coordinates to contacts without server round-trips.
messenger.maps.community.desc: Tile packs can be shared via trusted sources (onion/community mirrors).
messenger.maps.exporter.title: Maps Exporter
messenger.maps.exporter.desc: Generate offline tile packs locally in your browser. Tile sources are only contacted after explicit user selection.
messenger.maps.exporter.link: Learn how offline tile exports work
messenger.maps.link: Explore offline maps and secure location sharing
messenger.distribution.title: Offline Distribution
messenger.distribution.desc.after: Anonomi can be shared directly between Android devices using local connections, even when the internet is unavailable, monitored, or unsafe.
messenger.distribution.d2d.desc: Share the app directly between Android devices over local connections — no internet or app store required.
messenger.distribution.catalog.desc: A built-in offline kit bundles Anonomi and companion apps for distribution in disconnected environments.
messenger.distribution.noInternet.desc: The entire sharing process works over local connections — Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, or removable storage.
messenger.distribution.verified.desc: Shared app files include checksums so recipients can verify the app hasn’t been tampered with during transfer.
messenger.postbox.title: Anonomi Postbox
messenger.postbox.desc.highlight: Receive messages while your main device is offline.
messenger.postbox.desc.after: Anonomi Postbox is a companion app installed on a separate Android device. It stays online and collects encrypted messages on your behalf, then delivers them automatically when your main device reconnects.
messenger.postbox.storeForward.desc: Messages arrive at the Postbox while you are offline and are delivered when your main device comes back online.
messenger.postbox.e2ee.desc: The Postbox cannot read your messages. It only stores and forwards encrypted data.
messenger.postbox.qr.desc: Link a Postbox to your account by scanning a QR code. No accounts, servers, or cloud services involved.
messenger.postbox.optional.desc: Anonomi works without a Postbox. Use it only if asynchronous delivery fits your threat model.
messenger.threat.heading: Threat model (pragmatic)
messenger.threat.desc: Anonomi assumes that in serious cases: network traffic is monitored and contacts may eventually be compromised.
messenger.threat.assumptions.1: • Traffic from/to the device may be monitored.
messenger.threat.assumptions.3: • Contacts may be compromised over time.
messenger.threat.assumptions.4: • Physical inspection is a realistic risk.
messenger.threat.goals.1: • Avoid centralized servers that can be seized or subpoenaed.
messenger.threat.goals.2: • Provide offline options when networks are unsafe.
messenger.threat.goals.3: • Reduce metadata leakage in everyday workflows.
messenger.threat.goals.4: • Offer safety tools for coercive scenarios.
messenger.threat.link: Read the full threat model and design assumptions
messenger.download.desc: Anonomi is currently available for Android. Distribution is intentionally conservative: releases are signed, verifiable, and designed to be shared even without access to app stores.
messenger.download.messenger.desc: The main app. Decentralized messaging over Tor or offline transports, with private payments, offline maps, and safety tools built in.
messenger.download.postbox.desc: Companion app for asynchronous message delivery. Install on a separate device to receive messages while your main phone is offline.
messenger.download.verification: Releases are signed and published with checksums. In high-risk environments, always verify before installing.
messenger.download.apkSize.link: Why is the APK so large?
messenger.download.noPlayStore: No Google Play, no trackers, no silent updates. Anonomi is distributed outside centralized app stores by design.
messenger.download.ios.title: About iOS support
messenger.download.ios.desc: Anonomi is Android-only. iOS imposes architectural and policy constraints that prevent providing the level of privacy, network control, and offline operation required by Anonomi’s threat model. Supporting iOS would mean compromising on guarantees this project is not willing to weaken.
messenger.download.ios.link: Read why Anonomi will never support iOS

paylinks.onionOnly.heading: Paylinks is available only on the onion site
paylinks.onionOnly.description: Paylinks has moved to Tor. Creating, managing, and donating through a paylink now happens exclusively on the Anonomi onion website — this clearnet page cannot carry out those actions.
paylinks.onionOnly.reason: The Paylinks service is reachable only as a Tor onion service, and it accepts requests only from the onion website. Running it on Tor alone keeps donation traffic inside the network it was designed for, and removes the clearnet hosting and DNS that a donation service should not have to depend on.

paylinks.onionOnly.torRequired: Onion addresses open only in Tor Browser. Copy the address above rather than following a link from a clearnet page, and check it character by character against an address published in our documentation.

paylinks.create.label.viewKeyHelp: Stored encrypted on the server. Used only to derive subaddresses server-side.
paylinks.create.label.label: Label (optional)
paylinks.create.label.labelHelp: This label appears on the payment page as a subtitle, helping donors recognize who they're donating to. It is optional.
